name: Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings
oracle_text:
First strike
Whenever you draw a card, put a +1/+1 counter on Shang-Chi.
When the tenth +1/+1 counter is put on Shang-Chi, you draw five cards and gain 5 life.
blocked_sentences: When the tenth +1/+1 counter is put on Shang-Chi, you draw five cards and gain 5 life.

needs.what: a counter_placed trigger that fires exactly once when a placement of the given kind on this permanent carries its count across N (before < N <= before + amount), e.g. trigger {event: counter_placed, source: self, counter: "+1/+1", nth: 10}; the event payload would need the pre-placement count, the way add_counters already reads `before` for Saga chapters
needs.why_existing_wont_do: counter_placed fires on every placement and its payload carries only the amount, not the count before it; `nth` on a trigger is defined only for draw and spell_cast ordinals; a `counters_on >= 10` condition fires again on every later counter (and an intervening-if recheck would misread it); the `state` trigger fires on the count holding, not on the tenth counter arriving; `chapter` handles the crossing logic but only for lore counters on Sagas
